process_area.title: Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics

value_stream.name: Skilled-Trade Apprenticeship, Vocational Education & Capability Pipeline

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, TA Marketing (links to VS-121/W3777), L&D (links to VS-19.4), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Compliance (links to VS-22), Government Affairs (links to VS-104), Legal (links to VS-100.3)

workflows.name: Vocational School, Senior-High & TESDA Partner Network Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify and onboard partner schools" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-measure of "measure partner-network yield" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: partner-ROI analytics; operational: curriculum alignment
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-yield-partner risk**: Partners that don't produce candidates; mitigated by partner-ROI analytics
- **Misaligned-curriculum risk**: School curriculum out of step with BuildRight needs; mitigated by curriculum alignment
System Touchpoints: - TA/campus (links to VS-121/W3777); legal/MOA (links to VS-100.3/W688); L&D (links to VS-19.4); government affairs (links to VS-104); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/TA-Marketing build and manage the vocational/TESDA/senior-high partner network: identify and onboard partner schools (near store/DC regions), establish MOAs (links to VS-100.3/W688), align curricula (links to W3810), and engage TESDA regional offices (links to W3811/VS-104)

Trade Capability/Store-Ops run ongoing partner engagement: joint curriculum/immersion, BuildRight store/DC tours, guest lectures, instructor exchange, scholarship/sponsorship, and partner relationship management
Trade Capability/Analytics measure partner-network yield (candidates, OJT-to-hire conversion, partner ROI — links to W3832/W3784) and optimize the partner portfolio

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, TA Marketing (links to VS-121), HR (links to VS-19.1), L&D (links to VS-19.4), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Compliance (links to VS-22), Data Privacy (links to VS-91)

workflows.name: Vocational Feeder Pipeline, OJT Placement & School-to-Work Transition

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "route qualified candidates to apprentice intake" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "capture performance for conversion" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track transition outcomes" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: nurture and transition tracking; operational: RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Pipeline-leakage risk**: Leads captured but not converted; mitigated by nurture and transition tracking
- **Compliance risk**: Student data handled unlawfully; mitigated by RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - TA/talent CRM (links to VS-121/W3770); recruiting (links to VS-19.1); L&D (links to VS-19.4); data privacy (links to VS-91); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/TA-Marketing operate the vocational feeder pipeline: capture consented student leads from partners into the talent community (links to VS-121/W3770), nurture with BuildRight trade content, and route qualified candidates to apprentice intake (links to W3814) or direct hire

Trade Capability/HR manage OJT/practicum placement: place partner-school students into BuildRight OJT slots, supervise and assess per school and BuildRight standards (links to W3819), and capture performance for conversion
steps.r: Trade Capability / HR / Store Ops / L&D

steps.activity: Trade Capability/HR run school-to-work transition: convert successful OJT students into apprentices (links to W3814) or regular roles (links to W3822), ensure compliant data handling (links to VS-91), and track transition outcomes (links to W3832)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, L&D (links to VS-19.4), HR (links to VS-19/VS-102), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Master Tradespersons, TESDA (links to W3811)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Trade Capability/L&D build the instructor/master-trainer pipeline" (replaces manual Step 1).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: pipeline development; operational: recognition and career path
Pain Points / Risks: - **Instructor-shortage risk**: Insufficient qualified instructors; mitigated by pipeline development
- **Instructor-attrition risk**: Master trainers leave; mitigated by recognition and career path
System Touchpoints: - L&D (links to VS-19.4); competency/cert (links to W683); compensation (links to VS-102); recognition (links to W630); TESDA (links to W3811)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/L&D build the instructor/master-trainer pipeline: identify high-potential master tradespersons, develop them into certified trainers/assessors (TESDA Trainers Methodology/Certified Trainer where applicable — links to W3811), and plan succession for instructor roles

Trade Capability/L&D qualify and develop instructors: training-the-trainer, coaching/assessment skills, curriculum delivery standards, and ongoing instructor development/certification (links to VS-19.4/W683)
Trade Capability/HR recognize and retain instructors/master-trainers (recognition links to W630, compensation links to VS-102, career path links to W3822) to sustain the instructor base

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, Quality (links to VS-31), Compliance (links to VS-22), L&D (links to VS-19.4), Master Tradespersons/Assessors, TESDA (links to W3811)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review, and conflict-of-interest controls" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: calibration/moderation; operational: COI controls and double-scoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inconsistent-grading risk**: Different assessors grade differently; mitigated by calibration/moderation
- **Assessor-bias risk**: Impartiality compromised; mitigated by COI controls and double-scoring
System Touchpoints: - Quality (links to VS-31); compliance (links to VS-22); L&D (links to VS-19.4); TESDA (links to W3811)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/Quality qualify assessors per standard: assessor qualification (TESDA-accredited where applicable — links to W3811), assessment criteria training, and authorization to assess specific trades/competencies

Trade Capability/Quality run assessor calibration and standardization: regular calibration sessions, moderation of scoring, double-scoring samples, and bias control so assessments are consistent across assessors/stores/regions
Trade Capability/Compliance manage assessor recertification, performance review, and conflict-of-interest controls (assessor impartiality)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, L&D (links to VS-19.4/W684/W1484), Merchandising (links to VS-01.3), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Master Tradespersons, Innovation/Knowledge (links to VS-30.3), IT (links to VS-27/VS-75)

workflows.name: Trade Knowledge Management, Content Library & Curriculum Asset Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "capture and codify master-tradesperson tacit knowledge" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: knowledge codification; operational: content refresh cycle
Pain Points / Risks: - **Tacit-knowledge-loss risk**: Master expertise lost when experts leave; mitigated by knowledge codification
- **Stale-content risk**: Content out of date with products; mitigated by content refresh cycle
System Touchpoints: - L&D/LMS (links to VS-19.4); document/knowledge (links to VS-30.3/W687/W684); product info (links to VS-01.3); SOP library (links to W1459); mobile (links to VS-75)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/L&D build and maintain the trade knowledge and content library: theory modules, practical guides, video demonstrations, product/brand content (links to VS-01.3), SOPs (links to W1459 store SOP library), and trade-mastery reference material — managed as versioned curriculum assets (links to W687/W684)

Trade Capability/IT/Merchandising publish and deliver content via mobile/LMS (links to VS-75/VS-19.4/W51), ensure accessibility across stores/DCs, and keep content current with products/categories (links to VS-01.1)

Trade Capability capture and codify master-tradesperson tacit knowledge (lumber-grading heuristics, tint recipes links to W898, estimation shortcuts links to VS-09.2) into the library before it is lost to attrition

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, HR/People Analytics (links to VS-103.3), Strategy (links to VS-33), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Workforce Planning (links to VS-103.3), Finance (links to VS-17.4), L&D (links to VS-19.4)
fields.Trigger: Workforce planning cycle (links to VS-103.3); store growth (links to VS-37)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "headcount vs need by store/region/trade, expected attrition" (replaces manual Step 1).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: demand modeling and pipeline; operational: workforce-planning linkage
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capability-shortfall risk**: Demand outruns supply of certified trade staff; mitigated by demand modeling and pipeline
- **Misalignment risk**: Apprenticeship output not matched to actual role demand; mitigated by workforce-planning linkage
System Touchpoints: - People analytics (links to VS-103.3); strategy (links to VS-33); store growth (links to VS-37); finance (links to VS-17.4); TA (links to VS-121)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/HR model trade-capability demand and supply: current certified-trade headcount vs need by store/region/trade, expected attrition (links to VS-103.3), store-growth demand (links to VS-37), and service-revenue demand (links to VS-09/VS-12)
Trade Capability/HR translate the gap into the apprenticeship/cohort plan and TA trade sourcing (links to W3817/VS-121), and into retention actions for existing trade staff
Trade Capability publish trade-capability workforce analytics to executive (links to VS-33.2/VS-36) and feed corporate workforce planning (links to VS-103.3)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, Compliance (links to VS-22), Audit (links to VS-21), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Records (links to VS-88), L&D (links to VS-19.4), TESDA/DOLE

workflows.name: Trade-Certification Compliance Audit & External Accreditation Maintenance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "reporting, and accreditation renewal" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Trade Capability/Audit run internal compliance audit of the apprenticeship" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "Trade Capability/Compliance support TESDA/DOLE inspection" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: maintenance and audit; operational: internal audit and closure
Pain Points / Risks: - **Accreditation-loss risk**: Program loses TESDA accreditation; mitigated by maintenance and audit
- **Compliance-finding risk**: Audit reveals deficiencies; mitigated by internal audit and closure
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (links to VS-22); audit (links to VS-21); legal (links to VS-100.3); records (links to VS-88); L&D (links to VS-19.4); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/Compliance maintain TESDA program accreditation and registration in good standing (links to W3811): facility/instructor/assessor qualification, standards currency, reporting, and accreditation renewal

Trade Capability/Audit run internal compliance audit of the apprenticeship (records links to W3815, assessment consistency links to W3828, DOLE compliance links to W3812) and manage findings to closure
Trade Capability/Compliance support TESDA/DOLE inspection (links to VS-22.2), manage findings, and report compliance posture to audit/governance (links to VS-21/VS-36)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, Analytics (links to VS-28.1), People Analytics (links to VS-103.3), Finance (links to VS-17.4), L&D (links to VS-19.4), Store Ops (links to VS-07), In-Store Services (links to VS-09), CHRO

workflows.name: Trade-Capability Analytics, ROI & Program Effectiveness Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure program effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report trade-capability and program ROI to executive" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-600 (ensure controlled execution — Vocational Partnerships, Instructor Pipeline & Trade Capability Analytics (PA-123.3).)
- operational: ROI analytics; operational: effectiveness metrics
Pain Points / Risks: - **ROI-opacity risk**: Program value not measurable; mitigated by ROI analytics
- **Effectiveness-blindness risk**: Weak completion/retention undetected; mitigated by effectiveness metrics
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (links to VS-28.1); people analytics (links to VS-103.3); finance (links to VS-17.4); executive reporting (links to VS-33.2); board/ESG (links to VS-36/VS-25.3); sales enablement (links to VS-124)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/Analytics measure program effectiveness: intake → completion → certification → placement → retention, apprentice quality/performance vs external hires, certification rates, and time-to-productivity

Trade Capability/Finance measure program ROI: cost per certified apprentice (links to W3812), productivity/service-quality/attach uplift (links to VS-124), service-revenue contribution (links to VS-09/VS-12), and reduced external-hire/training cost

Trade Capability/CHRO report trade-capability and program ROI to executive (links to VS-33.2/VS-36) and the board talent/sustainability lens (links to VS-25.3), and translate into program/budget actions (links to W3809/W3812)
